crossRefs.note: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.
translations.bsb: Saul came to the city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley.
translations.kjv: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
translations.asv: And Saul came to the city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
